purpose: Measure participant-level false flags under a frozen advisory behavioral policy and matched declared automation
primaryUnit: independently supervised consenting participant; never attempts
primaryEndpoint: any behavioral false flag within first three prescheduled attempts; unknown outcomes retained
thresholdRule: Phase5 calibration-only empirical 1% target; owner freezes exact numerical threshold before final access
sampleMinimumInterpretation: Draft feasibility/precision gates only; not sufficient recruitment targets or guarantees of population FPR
splits: connected participant/session/device/family/seed/script/source/model/trace lineage; frozen pilot and prospective cohorts
inclusion: Adult able to provide informed consent
environmentAnalysis: separate behavior-only/environment-only/combined development diagnostics; never operator identity or ground truth
sensitiveDemographics: Do not collect ages, disability diagnoses or other sensitive traits without separately justified consent/review
access: Owner and named approved evaluator, local private copies only; no automatic uploads
withdrawal: Revoke first; remove supported participant copies and invalidate dependent artifacts; retain final-use lock and sensitive minimal revocation ledger
pauseStop: Unexplained false flags or accessibility exclusion
releasePolicy: observe-only; no automatic model promotion, ML blocking, deployment or recruitment
